description: Adds new end-game items such as the warp totem to the game.

# Totems!
**Warp Totems** is a datapack that adds new end-game items such as the warp totem to your game!

<details>
<summary>✨ Content</summary>
  
- 1 New end-game item
  
- A vanilla friendly balanced way of teleporting
</details>
